required_upstream: MAI/ISE/SSA/VTI and World/Scene/Exploration/Combat owner contracts available
boundaries: MCS is map-specific authoring/presentation tooling and does not become canonical World, Scene, Combat, Exploration, Visibility, Settlement, Economy or social-state authority
map elements explicitly distinguish presentation-only, owner-projected and binding-proposal states
pixels, vectors, labels, imported metadata and generator output never silently create canonical game/world truth
MCS consumes MAI/ISE/SSA/VTI foundations instead of replacing them
all imported/generated media resources and derivatives preserve ARI identity/provenance/rights rules
PCA supplies reusable production/generator primitives; MCS owns map-specific user-facing composition and editing
MCCS is the strict planned successor after MCS-21 and owns the separate Character/creature creator surface before SMB-08
generic DCC/CAD/GIS/vector/raster capabilities should use lawful mature libraries/tools where practical rather than being rebuilt as general-purpose applications
proprietary benchmark products are clean-room planning provenance only; protected code/assets/styles/UI expression are not copied
no paid mapping provider is required for blocking workflows
no implementation authority until separately governed start
